_readme: WP39 spike: six-requirement-passing designs within the near-frontier band (the K = 1 band, as at every K) of the fits of record, per regime. Values rounded to 7 significant digits. logV1/logV2 are the K = 1 and K = 2 levels; pos is the position along the first principal direction of the near-frontier chart. Computed by a scratchpad script on examples/adcs/case.py and the committed data/v2 tables.
